title: inferencekit run manifest v1
description: What an agent ran: model at a pinned revision, hardware, every engine with its install and launch commands, the workload and the frozen harness. A re-run of the manifest replays exactly this on a clean host. Semantic rules that JSON Schema cannot express (unique engine labels, distinct ports, no secret values in env) are checked by `inferencekit manifest validate`.

revision.description: Full 40-character commit sha of the model repo (a branch or tag can move).

precision.description: Weight precision class, e.g. bf16, fp8, nvfp4, q8_0.

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer repo id, when it differs from the model.

local_dir.description: Where launch commands expect the weights, relative to the re-run's working directory (the uploaded copy of the agent's run directory), e.g. models/qwen3-8b. A re-run runs `hf download <id> --revision <revision> --local-dir <local_dir>`. Without it the model goes to the HF cache and launch commands must name the repo id and the revision.

backend.description: CPU hosts use an exclusive CPU lock and process-group RSS; other backends retain the GPU route.

cpu.description: CPU identity from doctor or cpu screen-manifest; optional topology and allowed CPU facts.

gpu.description: GPU model as nvidia-smi names it, or a substring of that name (e.g. 'RTX 5090').

name.description: Engine family: vllm, sglang, llamacpp, trtllm, custom...

label.description: Unique label for this engine + configuration; used as a directory name.

install.description: Shell commands run in order inside this engine's own venv (VIRTUAL_ENV is set).

env.description: Environment for the server. null = inherit that variable from the caller (e.g. a token). Never secret values: name secrets in a re-run instead.

host.description: Address the harness connects to (default 127.0.0.1). A re-run runs every engine on the host it measures, so it must be a loopback address.

cwd.description: Working directory of the server, relative to the re-run's working directory (the uploaded copy of the agent's run directory). Default: that directory.

ready_check.description: HTTP path polled until it returns 200, e.g. /v1/models or /health.

resolved_config.description: What the engine logged it actually used.

endpoint_kind.description: Client contract for bench rounds. Audio and image use the contracts in docs/media-benchmarks.md.

workflow.description: comfyui: the API-format workflow JSON (a path relative to the manifest is resolved there).

settings.description: Audio/image generation settings passed unchanged to every arm.

clips.description: Clip set JSONL for --mode clip (sha256 pinned by bench clip records).

chat_template_kwargs.description: Sent as chat_template_kwargs on every chat request to every engine (bench serve, bench rounds, gates run, quality trajectory), e.g. {"enable_thinking": false} to pin a reasoning model's template; a prompt record's own chat_template_kwargs field is merged over it per key. When the run's intake pins workload.chat_template_kwargs (intake.normalized.json next to the manifest), every pinned key must be here with the pinned value (manifest validate, bench rounds and a re-run refuse otherwise).

extra_body.description: Merged last into the body of every timed request to every engine: bench rounds passes it to each bench serve call as --extra-body (bench rounds --extra-body overrides it). Use it to time sampling instead of greedy decoding, e.g. {"temperature": 1.0, "top_k": 64, "top_p": 0.95, "seed": 1234}. Absent: bench serve times greedy decoding (temperature 0) on every engine. manifest validate refuses fields that change what is timed or how it is read (model, messages, prompt, stream, stream_options, max_tokens, max_completion_tokens, n, best_of, ignore_eos, min_tokens, stop, stop_token_ids, logit_bias, return_token_ids, return_tokens_as_token_ids, logprobs, top_logprobs, echo, suffix), chat_template_kwargs (use workload.chat_template_kwargs) and secret-looking keys; it warns when top_k, top_p, min_p or seed come without a temperature above 0 (bench serve stays greedy).

wheel_sha256.description: sha256 of the inferencekit-cli wheel the agent ran (64 hex). Empty only while drafting; a re-run refuses it.
